connection: A fresh sqlite3 connection is opened per request via get_connection() in db.py; raw SQL, no ORM.
queries: Insert of a parking session at check-in, lookup of a session by id and update of exit_time and fee at check-out, select all sessions for the report endpoint.
transactions: One implicit transaction per request, committed explicitly.
n_plus_one: None in the original check-in/check-out flows; the report endpoint fetches all sessions in one query.
concurrency: None; sqlite3 default isolation with no explicit locking.

optimization_targets.description: Add a new daily_summary helper that aggregates parking sessions into a revenue summary.
Add a new report_endpoint that calls daily_summary and returns the aggregated report.

notes: The daily_summary function must be fully implemented before deployment — leaving it as a stub will cause the report endpoint to return invalid data.
